rationale: Add a short archived-payment exception: missing basket files linked from archived payments are not automatically inconsistent because the payment snapshot may survive.

dependencies.why: Record shape, status semantics, discount object semantics, and the 'no availability flag' rule.
Basket id, basket_status, store pointer, basket_created_at, and discount columns read by this registry.
Basket line shape (line_number, product_sku, requested_quantity) used in reconciliation.
Archived-payment semantics: older payments can carry line snapshots after basket files age out.

rollback.strategy: Revert to v0003 if archived-payment wording causes live basket lookups to skip ordinary missing-basket unsupported outcomes.
